## Summary

I implemented the fix for numericality validation with an `equal_to` constraint on decimal columns, so comparisons use the value *as stored* (after applying the column's precision/scale) rather than the raw input.

### Changes to source files

**`activemodel/lib/active_model/validator.rb`**
- `EachValidator#validate` now passes the value through a new `prepare_value_for_validation(value, record, attr_name)` hook before calling `validate_each`. Added a base implementation that returns the value unchanged.

**`activemodel/lib/active_model/validations/numericality.rb`**
- `validate_each` now accepts `precision:` (default `Float::DIG`) and `scale:` keyword arguments and threads them through parsing/comparison.
- The raw-value extraction logic (before-type-cast / read_attribute / changed-in-place handling) moved out of `validate_each` into an override of `prepare_value_for_validation`, so the base validator drives it uniformly.
- `parse_as_number` now takes `precision`/`scale` and routes floats/float-parsed strings through a new `parse_float`, which truncates to `scale` (when given) and converts with `to_d(precision)` — so digits beyond the column's precision are dropped before comparison.
- Added `HEXADECIMAL_REGEX` constant.

**`activerecord/lib/active_record/validations/numericality.rb`** (new)
- `ActiveRecord::Validations::NumericalityValidator` subclasses the ActiveModel one and overrides `validate_each` to derive `precision`/`scale` from the column via `type_for_attribute` (capped at `BigDecimal.double_fig`), then calls `super`. Redefines `validates_numericality_of` in `ClassMethods` to use this validator.
